transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the waste-disposition huddle. We've got eighteen totes of spent solvent from the cleaning process staged in the waste area, and I need to review the findings and sign off on the final disposition and shipment plan. Can the environmental compliance specialist and logistics coordinator please report their findings?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important finding from my laboratory review this morning. The spent solvent has been classified as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II, rather than routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. I have not yet entered this classification into the formal waste register because I'm waiting for your disposition signature, Mara.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I confirmed with our licensed hazardous-waste carrier that they will accept these 18 drums only for a Friday 16:00 pickup, provided they are arranged on exactly 3 pallets and the manifest is submitted by 12:00 Friday. I have not booked the pickup yet because the waste classification was awaiting confirmation, which Jonas has now provided.
transcript.speaker: A3
